verdicts.reason: A opens the left-to-right reading order with the legal fine print, set almost as large as the subhead. Its logo is shrunk to an unreadable speck under the product, the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon is a tiny afterthought jammed beside the subhead, and the headline nearly runs into the CTA. B has a clean centred stack (headline > subhead > subordinate legal) with the CTA clearly on the right, but its sale ribbon is cropped hard against the top-left canvas edge, the logo is a tiny cluster under it, and the left third is cramped while big gaps sit on either side of the text.
